decisions.setIdentity: Original 1999 Fleer Ultra Baseball flagship set issued November 1998, one 250-card series, first single-series Ultra since 1991. Confirmed pre-import no matching Product, PR or factory branch. NOT Fleer Tradition or 1999 basketball/football Ultra.
decisions.base: Cards #1–210 standard, five player-fronted checklists #211–215, 10 Season Crowns #216–225 short-printed 1:8, and 25 Prospects #226–250 short-printed 1:4. Original physical card #215 is Ken Griffey, Jr. checklist; #211 Kerry Wood. 250 cards all checked number/name/team vs BCP and independent CollectionCount. Three specific BCP missing Jr. suffix (#178 Sandy Alomar, #213 Cal Ripken, #215 Ken Griffey) corrected using independent source.
decisions.rookieFlags: TCDB currently reports 0 flagged RCs and CollectionCount similarly lists 0; 13 men who met rookie thresholds in 1999 appear as Prospects or inserts, but do not stamp design-specific RC labels without official checklist confirmation. Prospect-themed is not synonymous with true RC.
decisions.parallels: Gold Medallion complete 250 cards, printed G suffix; 215 normal Gold cards one per hobby pack, 10 short-printed Gold Season Crowns 1:80 hobby, 25 Gold Prospects 1:40 hobby. Platinum Medallion also 250 with P suffix, serial-numbered /99 for regular #1–215, /50 for Season Crowns #216–225 and /65 for Prospects #226–250; no invented /99 for all. Masterpiece authentic full 250-card 1/1 dark purple foil and back stamp, derived from Base only. All parallels hobby exclusive.
decisions.inserts: Six authentic inserts, 105 cards: RBI Kings 30 retail exclusive one per pack; The Book On 20 1:6 hobby/retail; World Premiere 15 1:18; Thunderclap 15 1:36; Damage Inc. 15 1:72; Diamond Producers 10 die-cut 1:288. Every subject/number/team compared against BCP and independently-maintained CollectionCount. Original insert suffix printed n RK/BO/WP/TC/DI/DP stored in Card.cardNumber.
decisions.promos: Six separate actual stamped PROMOTIONAL SAMPLE singles cut from a dealer/media uncut sheet, with Kerry Wood, Mark McGwire, Nomar Garciaparra, Andruw Jones, Alex Rodriguez, Kenny Lofton. Uses clearly named virtual SAMPLE-01..06 inventory IDs because physical promo checklist is unnumbered; do not invent printed numbering. Do not count the sheet six extra times. Never in wax.
decisions.distribution: Hobby 10 cards per pack and 24 packs per box at $2.69 original manufacturer MSRP. BCP did not publish verifiable exact retail cards per pack or box configuration, so do not invent. Retail-only RBI Kings remain a different pack channel.
decisions.pricing: Historical MSRP $2.69 is not a fair present-day virtual pack value; zero initial imported VCS price with autoPackPricing and released false, no changes to other products.
decisions.collation: Current VCS pack engine lacks retail/hobby separation, true Season Crowns/Prospects subgroups, and a guaranteed hobby Gold slot. All oddsPerPack deliberately null rather than fabricating pack rates. Public release gated until format-aware and subgroup-aware collation, accurate images and pricing are checked.
decisions.images: No fabricated card fronts, player poses, Dufex textures, promo sheet or packaging; real scans required for publication. No other VCS sets, prices, photos or collections modified.

productSets.name: Base Set
productSets.notes: One series #1–250: regular #1–210, five checklists #211–215, Season Crowns #216–225 (SP 1:8), Prospects #226–250 (SP 1:4). Source records 0 formal rookie-card badges; prospect label is not RC.

productSets.name: Gold Medallion
productSets.notes: Complete 250-card Gold Medallion in original G-suffix numbering, metallic gold matte foil and back foil stamp. Hobby #1G–215G one per pack, Season Crowns #216G–225G 1:80, Prospects #226G–250G 1:40. Exclude retail.

productSets.name: Platinum Medallion
productSets.notes: All 250 base subjects in original P-suffix IDs: #1P–215P serialized /99; Season Crowns #216P–225P /50; Prospects #226P–250P /65. Hobby-only. Correct individually printed tier metadata.

productSets.name: Masterpiece (1/1)
productSets.notes: True 250-card, one-of-one dark purple foil 'THE ONLY 1 OF 1 MASTERPIECE EDITION'. Exact base identities, without guessing per-pack odds.
